reading: The sketch lays out a Slack-style messaging screen: a far-left icon rail, a dark workspace sidebar with channel/DM lists, a bold channel heading, a feed of three chat messages with avatars/reactions/thread link, an emoji-reaction input label with field, a message composer box with a send button and a typing indicator, and a right-hand thread panel listing three replies.
